_about: A few made-up business goals for the made-up company in this build. Triage links an item to one of them, or to none (R7 flags it). Goals are on items only: no person is scored.

goals.title: Shorten the quote-to-cash cycle
goals.description: Quotes, approvals, orders and invoices move without manual re-keying, so revenue lands sooner.

goals.title: Keep customer data accurate
goals.description: Accounts, contacts and cases are complete and free of duplicates, so every team trusts what it reads.

goals.title: Answer support cases faster
goals.description: Cases reach the right queue first time and agents spend less time on admin.

goals.title: Give leaders one view of the pipeline
goals.description: Reports and forecasts agree with finance, so planning meetings start from one set of numbers.

goals.title: Stay safe and compliant
goals.description: Access, retention and audit duties are met on time, with evidence.
